signal: FloQast opened a Berlin hub in April 2026 to grow across DACH and rolled out FloQast AI Agents for automating record-to-report workflows

email.body1:
Emily, saw FloQast open the Berlin hub for DACH and ship the AI Agents for record-to-report.

Expansion and new product open more enterprise accounts than the team can cover before new reps ramp, and that's where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for FloQast off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Emily, quick follow-up for FloQast.

Entering a new region raises the enterprise number faster than headcount can follow. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit it, so the gap shows up late and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings enterprise needs to hit target this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Emily, last bit of proof for FloQast.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how FloQast's reply rate likely compares to peer fintech and accounting-software teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Emily, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling enterprise pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Standing up a new region is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to an enterprise accounting-software motion? I'll tailor it to FloQast either way.
